test_title: PYST 1: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

The report lacks a clear justification (1)/ for the measures undertaken (2)/ and overlooks the impact (3)/ on a environment. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the incorrect article "**a**" before the noun "**environment**."
 
• Because "environment" begins with a vowel sound, it would at the very least require the article "an." However, when referring to the natural world collectively, standard English grammar dictates the use of the definite article "the."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**on the environment**," ensuring grammatical correctness and contextual clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The report lacks a clear justification for the measures undertaken and overlooks the impact **on the environment**."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "The report lacks a clear justification" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2: "for the measures undertaken"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3: "and overlooks the impact"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
